Summary: The sources indicate that in April 2026, the Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the Employment Situation on the 1st and 3rd, Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey on the 30th, and State Employment and Unemployment (Monthly) on the 9th and 10th. The Federal Reserve Bank of New York lists Initial Claims, Employment Cost Index, Gross Domestic Product 1st Release, Personal Income and the PCE Deflator, and the Weekly Economic Index for the 30th. The St. Louis Fed's FRED calendar includes the Euro Short Term Rate, Harmonized Indices of Consumer Prices (HICP), SOFR Averages and Index Data, U.S. Import and Export Price Indexes, Business Leaders Survey, Overnight Bank Funding Rate Data, Federal Funds Data, Risk-On Risk-Off Index, St. Louis Fed Economic News Index, Moody's Daily Corporate Bond Yield Averages, G.17 Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization, Commercial Paper, Monthly Treasury Statement, State Unemployment Insurance Weekly Claims Report, Treasury International Capital: Continuous Securities Long Term (CSLT), H.15 Selected Interest Rates, H.8 Assets and Liabilities of Commercial Banks in the United States, Interest Rate
